title: Normalized strict mixed-unit comparison interfaces
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E,L/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite coefficient fields, $\iota:E\to L$ a coefficient embedding and $f:X\to Y$ a scheme morphism. Retain the ordinary inverse-limit functor and total derived unit, sectionwise and whole-complex normalized limit/direct-image and restriction/direct-image comparisons, their reduction mates through the specified strict reconstructions, the scalar-adjunction mixed unit, and their finite evaluation predicates. FiniteLaws records the finite mixed-unit equality and the bijective lift map; CoherentLaws records the normalized entire-system data, the system mixed-unit equality, and its bijective lift map. These are the existing literal definitions from the strict mixed-unit module, relocated without changes to their signatures or bodies.
